title: Generalization properties of the token perceptron: the role of embedding and vocabulary
abstract: arXiv:2610.32788v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are trained to predict tokens from a finite vocabulary, each represented by a vector in a $d$-dimensional embedding space. Therefore, token prediction is a classification problem whose classes have a geometry determined by the embedding. We study how this geometry affects learning in a minimal solvable model: a linear predictor that maps a sequence of $N$ embedded tokens to a $d$-dimensional output through one $d\times d$ matrix per position, trained in the teacher--student setting. We call this the \textit{token perceptron}. We compute its generalization error with the replica method, taking $N\to\infty$ at fixed number of examples per position $\alpha=P/N$ and keeping $d$ and the vocabulary size $D$ finite. As a first reference case, we consider continuous embeddings on the sphere, which isolate the role of the embedding dimension. translated_title: 词元感知机的泛化性质：嵌入与词表的作用
translated_abstract: 大语言模型被训练用于从有限词表中预测词元，每个词元由 d 维嵌入空间中的一个向量表示。因此，词元预测本质上是一个分类问题，其类别的几何结构由嵌入决定。我们研究这种几何结构如何影响一个最小可解模型中的学习：该模型是一个线性预测器，通过每个位置上一个 d×d 的矩阵，将 N 个嵌入词元的序列映射为 d 维输出，并在教师-学生框架下进行训练。我们将其称为“词元感知机”（token perceptron）。我们利用复制方法计算其泛化误差，在每位置样本数 α=P/N 固定的情况下取 N→∞，同时保持嵌入维度 d 和词表大小 D 有限。作为第一个参考情形，我们考虑球面上的连续嵌入，以分离出嵌入维度所起的作用。此时自然负载为 α/d，且当 d>1 时，归一化标签固定了 d……
tldr: 该论文提出“词元感知机”这一最小可解线性模型，并用复制方法解析计算其泛化误差，揭示了嵌入空间的几何结构与有限词表大小如何影响大语言模型中词元预测的学习与泛化。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the "token perceptron," a minimal solvable linear model whose generalization error is computed analytically via the replica method, revealing how embedding geometry and finite vocabulary size shape learning and generalization in token prediction for large language models.
